noughties.m: The decade consisting of the last year of the previous century and the first nine years of the next: from 1900 to 1909, 2000 to 2009, etc.

noumenal.m: Of or pertaining to the noumenon or the realm of things as they are in themselves.

nounal.m: Of, relating to, or acting as a noun.

nourisher.m: One who, or that which, nourishes.

nourishers.m: More than one nourisher. nourisher: one who, or that which, nourishes.

nourishingly.m: In a way that provides nourishment or food.
